profile.name: tree counter
profile.description: Counts street trees from Google Street View and compares them to city inventory data, with an agent handoff queue so each visit finishes one street or sub-ZIP.

memory.content: The user wants help most with coding and building.
Building a Google Street View agent to count trees in New Orleans against the city's official tree inventory.
Use an agent handoff queue for the tree-counter: claim one street or sub-ZIP at a time, write a compact summary, mark the unit complete so the next agent can continue.
